verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a speech-to-text API service, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, an MCP server, an x402 API and a ClawHub skill, but no first-party command-line tool. The MCP `prepare_upload` tool only returns an upload command for local files, which is an adjacent helper rather than an official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
